title: Attached Pull Prototype
purpose: Make the existing three suction tendrils mechanically causal during surface traversal: planted anchors publish support/load state and PlayerMovementController consumes those anchors to pull the Core tangentially while preserving the trusted authored movement boundary.
allowedScope: surface tendril anchor telemetry and load cadence
world-space stand-off distance from trusted authored boundary
organic tension tuning of existing tendrils
forbiddenScope: new player buttons or manual tendril selection
new raycasts, colliders, mesh-surface solvers, or navmeshes
wall/ceiling traversal guarantees or edge wrapping
movementGrammar: free float: existing camera-relative movement remains unchanged
acquire: existing chemistry/contact rules attach to trusted movement boundary
support: one to three sealed tendrils publish world-space anchors
pull: PlayerMovementController selects the leading sealed anchor aligned with current tangent intent and accelerates toward it
handoff: traction softens while one tendril peels/reaches and the other supports remain planted
rest: with no stick intent, tangential velocity settles while suction remains engaged
release: existing pull-away/chemistry-loss rules return the Core to free movement
acceptanceTests: on a broad surface, holding movement produces repeated visible anchor handoffs while the Core advances
surface motion slows during handoff and regains pull after support reseals
releasing the stick settles the Core instead of letting it skate indefinitely
the Core keeps a readable stand-off from the authored surface envelope
free-space movement and controls remain unchanged
no exit, route, combat, targeting, Bond, or verb regression
